analysis: The trial crashed with a nonzero train.py exit after consuming 366.43 allocated GPU-seconds. The supplied traceback only shows the worker's subprocess failure; it does not reveal the underlying exception or establish which training or verification stage failed. No validation score was returned, so this trial provides no evidence of improvement or regression against the 0.4412 reference or 0.505 SASRec baseline.
code_summary: Extended AttentiveSimilarity with learned positions and one causal Transformer block (one attention head, feed-forward width 2×dim, dropout 0.1). Nonempty histories are compacted in purchase order, encoded, projected, normalized to context embedding norms, and scattered back with zero padding. A feature-wise sigmoid gate initialized with zero weights and bias −2 blends encoded and original context. Candidate-conditioned attention, square-root normalization, separate context/target embeddings, and item bias remain. Training retains 64 negatives and existing optimization settings. Checkpoints save architecture configuration; the generated predictor reconstructs and strictly loads it while preserving four-dataset routing. Added padding, causality, gradient-flow, and checkpoint/predictor agreement checks, whose completion is unconfirmed.
